Architecture/block diagram (Fig 1.3), a slide titled "ODA Production Component: SDWAN Exemplar — NaaS Intent (Service and Operational)", showing the positioning of the SD-WAN exemplar against the IG1224 NaaS Operational Domain model and TR313C ODA Production Components.

Layout, left to right / top to bottom:

- **Engagement Management** (purple column, left) and **Intelligence Management** (grey column, right) flank the main model.
- **Party Management** (red band) sits above **Core Commerce Management** (dark grey band), both spanning the width of the main model.
- Below that, a green box labelled **NaaS SDWAN Service** sits above a horizontal "Decoupling and Integration" boundary.
- Below the boundary, three vertically-oriented red/maroon boxes represent, left to right: **Operational Domain Mngt (ODM)** containing "CFS" and, nested inside, "IP Service Technology Domain Controllers"; **E2E Service Mngt Domain (E2E SM)** containing "E2E SM" and the central highlighted box **"SDWAN Service Mngt Intelligent Controller"**; and a second **Operational Domain Mngt (ODM)** containing "CFS" and, nested inside, "Fibre and Line plant Inventory". Each of the three domain boxes is labelled "Service" (upper) and "Resource" (lower) internally, and a dashed horizontal line labelled "AN F3 Ref Point" runs beneath them.
- Red dots mark connection points between the SDWAN Service Mngt Intelligent Controller and each of the outer ODM domains.
- The whole model sits inside a box labelled "Production" (bottom right), with the tmforum logo in the corner.

This is a positioning/mapping diagram showing how the proposed SD-WAN Service Management Intelligent Controller (SMIC) sits between an E2E Service Management domain and two Operational Domain Managers (one for IP Service Technology Domain Controllers, one for Fibre and Line Plant Inventory), within the wider ODA Production component landscape.
